js.runLine: apify run                        # run locally; the only command that sets up the Apify environment and local storage
js.logCensoring: It censors tokens and credentials; output from `console.log` is not censored.

ts.runLine: apify run                        # run locally; the only command that sets up the Apify environment and local storage
ts.extraCommands: apify actor generate-schema-types  # generate TypeScript types from the .actor schemas
ts.logCensoring: It censors tokens and credentials; output from `console.log` is not censored.

python.runLine: apify run                        # run locally; the only command that sets up the Apify environment and local storage
python.logCensoring: It censors tokens and credentials; output from `print` and the standard `logging` module is not censored.

rust.runLine: cargo run                        # run locally; reads storage/key_value_stores/default/INPUT.json and writes to storage/
rust.logCensoring: Unlike the JavaScript and Python SDKs, the Rust SDK does not censor tokens and credentials in the log, so never log them.
